visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short dark hair, wearing a white turtleneck sweater and a pearl necklace, stands in a brightly lit, minimalist indoor studio. She smiles and gestures with both hands towards the camera. (2) She holds a light purple, square-shaped makeup compact in her right hand, bringing it close to the lens. The background is blurred, focusing on the sleek plastic surface of the product. (3) A close-up shot shows the interior of the compact. She uses her index finger to press into the beige, mochi-like foundation material, demonstrating its soft, elastic texture. Her nails are manicured in a deep burgundy color. (4) The woman applies the foundation to the left side of her face using a black teardrop-shaped puff. On-screen text labels 'Before' and 'After' appear to highlight the coverage. (5) She touches her cheek with her finger, showing the skin's smooth, radiant finish under bright studio lighting. (6) She holds a small, round, purple makeup tool and places it inside a shiny silver handbag, demonstrating its portability. (7) A sequence shows her in different environments—indoors with soft lighting and outdoors on a balcony with natural daylight—to test the makeup's longevity over 4 hours. (8) She appears again at the 8-hour mark, pointing to her face to show the foundation's endurance. (9) She introduces a small, rectangular tube of Maybelline cheek blush with a yellow cap and a pinkish-brown liquid inside. (10) She uses a white tissue to wipe a portion of the foundation from her cheek, revealing the contrast between the covered and uncovered areas to prove its high coverage. (11) She holds the purple compact next to her face, smiling confidently as she concludes the presentation.
